shared_inputs.notes: Dense array indexed by p_partkey (dense_pk). Scan all 2M entries to identify qualifying partkeys for 3 OR branches.

operators.description: Scan part dense array (2M entries). For each partkey, evaluate 3 OR branches on part-side predicates only. Store qualifying partkeys with their branch tag (1/2/3).

branches.predicate: p_brand = 'Brand#12' AND p_container IN ('SM CASE','SM BOX','SM PACK','SM PKG') AND p_size BETWEEN 1 AND 5
p_brand = 'Brand#23' AND p_container IN ('MED BAG','MED BOX','MED PKG','MED PACK') AND p_size BETWEEN 1 AND 10
p_brand = 'Brand#34' AND p_container IN ('LG CASE','LG BOX','LG PACK','LG PKG') AND p_size BETWEEN 1 AND 15

operators.notes: Use branch_tag array: uint8[2000001] initialized to 0, set to 1/2/3 for qualifying parts. Enables O(1) branch lookup during lineitem probe.

operators.description: For each of ~4800 qualifying partkeys, read offsets to get lineitem row_id ranges. Collect all row_ids.
operators.notes: ~30 lineitem rows per partkey on average. Total ~144K row_ids gathered.

operators.description: Gather lineitem columns at collected row_ids. Apply common filters first (l_shipmode, l_shipinstruct), then branch-specific l_quantity range using branch_tag array from step 1.
operators.filter_order: Apply l_shipinstruct first (dict-encoded, cheapest), then l_shipmode (dict-encoded), then branch-specific l_quantity check using branch_tag[l_partkey].

operators.description: Single scalar SUM aggregation over ~2300 surviving rows. Use thread-local double accumulators, merge at end.

parallelism.notes: Partition the ~4800 qualifying partkeys across 16 threads. Each thread independently: looks up row_ids via grouped index, gathers lineitem columns, applies filters, accumulates into thread-local sum. 16 threads sufficient given small working set (~144K scattered row_ids). More threads would increase contention on random I/O without benefit. Final merge: sum 16 doubles.

data_structures.branch_tag_array: uint8[2000001] — indexed by p_partkey, value 0=not qualifying, 1/2/3=branch. Built in step 1, read in step 3.
data_structures.row_id_buffer: vector<uint32> per thread — holds gathered row_ids from index lookup
data_structures.accumulator: double per thread — thread-local SUM accumulator

indexes.purpose: Selective lineitem access: only read ~144K of 60M rows (0.24%)
